# Astrolabe MCP tools

<!-- Generated by `astrolabe mcp tools -md`. Do not edit; a test fails when this file is stale. -->

100 tools, the same over stdio (`astrolabe mcp`) and HTTP (`/mcp`). Each description also lists its sales-term equivalents.

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `account` | Everything about one account (id, company domain or company name): stage and days in it, next action, qualification checks with evidence (and which gating checks fail), people and their roles, evidence links, stage history, goal, timing, baseline, open tasks, conversation notes, and the signals and messages of the company and its people. |
| `add_account` | Put a company into a product's pipeline: company domain (or name), one line of evidence for why it belongs (a named person and a specific need or signal), and its one next action with a due date. |
| `add_signal` | Record an event about a person yourself (e.g. type=referral, strength 30). |
| `add_task` | Add a to-do with one next action and a due date (YYYY-MM-DD), optionally about a person. |
| `ai_draft` | Have the Claude API write a draft now from claims, voice, research and the triggering signal. |
| `ambiguous_matches` | Signals whose email/GitHub point at two different people. |
| `answer_reply` | Save an answer to a reply as an email draft in the same thread; approve it to send. |
| `approve` | Approve drafts exactly as saved. |
| `approve_creative` | Approve a creative exactly as it is now: the copy, the template and every rendered file, by hash. |
| `automation_runs` | Recent automation runs with outcome and the reason for skips. |
| `automations` | Automations per product (automations.yaml): trigger, when, action, and how many times each started a sequence, created a task or skipped. |
| `broadcast_approve` | Approve a broadcast exactly as saved and queue it for everyone confirmed now. |
| `broadcast_cancel` | Stop a broadcast: whatever is still queued is not sent. |
| `broadcast_create` | Draft a broadcast (one email to the whole updates list). |
| `broadcast_edit` | Change a draft broadcast's subject or text. |
| `broadcast_status` | Broadcasts of a product, or one by id: state (draft, approved, sending, sent, cancelled), how many were sent, are still queued, unknown (the provider's answer was lost; never resent, check the mailbox), failed or skipped (unsubscribed since), and what is holding it (daily cap, pause, missing postal address). |
| `campaign` | One campaign in full: goal, audience, offer, landing page, effective budget cap, dates and stop rule, gate items checked or not, spend so far, warnings, launch tasks, creatives with approval status, and recent changes. campaign is the file id or short code. |
| `campaign_history` | Every change to a campaign's budget, dates, stop rule and gate checks: who, when, old and new value. |
| `campaign_report` | Campaign report for its window: spend and the cap, the platform's clicks as entered, success events attributed to the campaign (signals or funnel events carrying campaign=<code>), each count with what it is out of, and what is not measured. |
| `campaigns` | List campaigns (a launch week, a small paid test) with dates, spend against the cap, gate status (how many pre-spend checks are done) and warnings. |
| `campaigns_json` | The campaigns.json export for a website to prerender per-campaign landing pages: a JSON array of {code,label} for campaigns that have not ended. |
| `check_gate` | Check (or uncheck) one pre-spend gate item by its text or number. |
| `check_sent` | For a send whose delivery is unknown: look for it in the sending mailbox's Sent folder by Message-ID. |
| `close_account` | Pause an account or mark it lost, with a reason from the product's list and a revisit date (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `close_task` | Close a to-do with an outcome: activated, paid, wrong_fit, unclear_value, setup_blocked, price, later, other. activated/paid also record the funnel stage. |
| `content` | Turn release notes or a post into drafts for x, linkedin, hn, reddit, newsletter, producthunt, directories, each with a tracked link. launch=true also adds a posting task per platform. |
| `content_list` | Recent content drafts and posts with click counts. |
| `content_mark` | Mark a content item posted (with its URL) or skipped. |
| `conversations` | Conversation notes, newest first, with counts of assisted and unassisted ones. |
| `counters` | Public counters from github_release monitors: release download counts per asset and in total, plus stars, forks, watchers, open issues and discussions, with the change over the last 7 days against the 7 before (both windows stated). |
| `creative_preview` | A creative's current copy filled into its template at one size, as a single HTML document with its stylesheets and images inlined: what a render would draw, available without the renderer. |
| `creatives` | A campaign's creatives (HTML template plus copy fields): copy, alt text, claims-check flags, rendered files and whether the approval still holds. |
| `digest` | This week's summary per product: what moved, automations, experiments, stuck people, uncontacted A-tier people, biggest drop, and up to three concrete actions. |
| `do_not_contact` | Put a person (id or email) on the do-not-contact list: no product will message them again. allow=true removes them. |
| `doctor` | Run the setup checks (astrolabe doctor): database, mode, password, products, mailboxes, channel secrets, public URL, webhooks and tokens, each ok, a warning or a problem, with the fix. connect=true also tests mailbox logins, the GitHub token, the Claude key and SPF/DMARC, without sending anything. |
| `edit_creative` | Change a creative's copy fields and/or alt text. |
| `experiments` | A/B results per sequence step: sends, replies, reached goal with 95% intervals, and a verdict (says when there is too little data). |
| `export_pack` | Write an approved pack to a folder for posting by hand: rendered files, copy, alt text, the posts and the landing page URL. |
| `forget_person` | Erase everything about one person on request (email or id): the person, addresses, messages sent and received, replies, research notes, scores, tasks, call notes, survey and pricing answers, form submissions (also at Netlify, through its API), list subscriptions and messages, funnel events, tracked links and clicks, payments rows and their mentions in free text; the account and company stay. |
| `form_submissions` | Recent form submissions (netlify_forms and form_webhook monitors) with the person, company and pipeline account each created, the self-reported source (how they said they heard of you) and the campaign code. |
| `funnel` | Funnel report for the last N days: people per stage, median days between stages, who is stuck, weekly cohorts, what brought people in (first touch and automation), form requests by the source people reported, revenue, spend, task outcomes. |
| `import_companies` | Import companies (no people needed) from CSV text with a header row: domain, company (or name), facts (';'-separated lowercase kind:value, e.g. fact:sells_to_enterprise;dep:bullmq), notes. |
| `import_people` | Import people from CSV text with a header row. |
| `import_spend` | Import a platform's spend and clicks CSV (header row with date, spend/cost/amount and optionally clicks, impressions, platform). |
| `inbox` | Everything waiting on the operator: sends needing a decision, replies to label, due tasks, drafts, and queued sends. |
| `label_reply` | Label a reply: interested, question, not_now, no, out_of_office, unsubscribe. no/unsubscribe add the person to do-not-contact; interested/question create a task; not_now creates a reminder (remind_on, default 30 days). |
| `log_conversation` | Log a call, email thread or chat with a person (and optionally their account): date, channel (call, email, chat, in_person, other), duration, assisted (we coached them; counted apart, never as unassisted first use) and five text fields: summary, their_words (exact quotes, they become marketing copy), problem, current_approach (what they do today) and next_step. |
| `log_mention` | Log a public mention of a product by hand: URL, optional title/excerpt, source (hn, stackoverflow, rss, github, manual, ...), date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today), tone and whether it asks a question. |
| `make_campaign_tasks` | Turn the campaign's launch tasks into tasks and content items (due on start date + day offset), each with the post text and a tracked link. |
| `monitors` | Status of each monitor in monitors.yaml: last run, new signals, errors. |
| `move_stage` | Move an account to another pipeline stage with one line of evidence (what happened). |
| `outbox` | Sandbox only: messages Astrolabe 'sent' (nothing left this machine). *(sandbox mode only)* |
| `pause` | Pause sending for global, product:<id> or sequence:<product>/<id>. |
| `people` | List or search a product's people by name, email or company domain, best priority first: score (fit, intent, why now), sequences, and the outreach guard's reason if the product may not email them. total counts all matches; limit defaults to 100. |
| `people_board` | A product's people by the furthest funnel stage each has reached (one column per stage of product.yaml funnel, plus people with no stage yet), with how long they have been there; each person is in exactly one column, so the columns add up to the total. |
| `person` | Everything about one person (id or email): identities and where each came from, how they said they heard of you (reported_source, apart from first touch), conversation notes, facts, scores with breakdown, research notes, sequences, messages, replies, signals, open tasks, do-not-contact, and for each product whether the outreach guard lets it email them (and why not). |
| `pipeline` | The account pipeline of a b2b product (pipeline: in product.yaml): open accounts per stage, paused and lost counts, each account's days in its stage and its one next action with the due date, plus stuck accounts (longer than stuck_after in one stage), overdue next actions, and paused or lost accounts whose revisit date has come. |
| `pipeline_export` | The pipeline as CSV: one row per account per week from the weekly snapshots (this week's is taken now if missing), with status, stage, days in stage, stuck, next action and due, overdue, reason, revisit date and each check's answer. |
| `pmf_survey` | The product-market-fit survey as counts: people per answer (very, somewhat, not disappointed), the total answers and people behind them, the window, and every answer with what they would use instead and who else would benefit. |
| `pricing_feedback` | What people said about price in a window: counts by offer, by what it would replace (comparison) and by buying process (card, invoice, procurement), with every statement and quote. |
| `product_context` | Everything needed to write for a product: one-liner, who it's for (target), offer, allowed claims (claims.md), never-claims and voice (voice.md). |
| `product_setup` | Create products/<id>/ from a short interview: name, one-liner, who it's for, funnel stages, activation stage, one offer (promise, call to action, URL), sender mailboxes, never-claims, and (if the operator agreed them) claims and voice text. |
| `products` | List loaded products: offer, funnel stages, sequences and their steps. |
| `qualify` | Answer an account's qualification checks: yes, no or unknown, each with one line of evidence (required for yes and no). |
| `reception` | Public mentions of a product (HN, Stack Overflow, RSS, GitHub, or logged by hand) over the last days days (default 7) with counts by tone (positive, mixed, negative, unknown), how many ask a question, and the window's dates. |
| `record_spend` | Record spend by hand: amount (e.g. 25 or 25.50, in the campaign's currency), platform, optional date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today), note, and the platform's clicks and impressions if you have them. |
| `record_stage` | Record that a person reached a funnel stage (e.g. installed). |
| `reload_products` | Re-read the product folders (after editing product.yaml, sequences, automations or monitors) and report any that failed to load. |
| `render_creative` | Render a creative to PNG (and PDF if asked) at each required size through the optional Chromium sidecar (docker compose --profile creative up, ASTROLABE_RENDER_URL). |
| `research` | Research notes on a person for a product via the Claude API: who they are, why now, fit, an angle, risks, with source links. |
| `resolve_match` | Attach an ambiguous signal to one candidate person, or dismiss it (omit person_id). |
| `resolve_send` | For a send whose delivery is unknown or failed: sent=true records it as sent; sent=false puts it back in drafts for a fresh approval. |
| `resume` | Resume a paused scope. |
| `reviews` | Saved weekly reviews for a product, newest week first, with how many questions were answered and decisions made. |
| `run_monitor` | Run one monitor now and store what it finds. |
| `save_review` | Save the review: answers to the review's questions (by number or exact text; an empty answer clears one) and a keep, change or stop decision with a note for each running experiment (its key) and campaign (its id or code). |
| `save_themes` | Save the week's themes for a product (week like 2026-W43, default this week): text, plus optional items with theme, count, exact quotes and a note. |
| `set_campaign` | Change a campaign's budget cap (a number such as 200 or 200.50), currency, start or end date (YYYY-MM-DD; end "" removes it), stop rule text, or the checkable stop rule (stop_spend_pct and stop_max_events: stop when that percent of the cap is spent with at most that many success events), or clear_stop_rule. |
| `set_company_facts` | Add kind:value facts to a company (id or domain) by hand; they count toward the company's fit and toward everyone who works there. |
| `set_facts` | Add kind:value facts to a person (dep:bullmq, lang:go, team:5-50) that fit rules match on; rescores. |
| `set_next_action` | Set an open account's one next action and its due date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today). |
| `set_tone` | Set the tone of a logged mention by id: positive, mixed, negative or unknown. |
| `setup` | Configuration as the operator checks it: loaded products with their folders, product folders that failed to load with each problem and its fix, sending mailboxes and whether each is connected, every pause switch (all sending, per product, per sequence) and webhook endpoints with whether their secret is set. |
| `signals` | Recent signals (GitHub issues, stars, HN/Stack Overflow threads, product events, manual notes) and who they're about. |
| `simulate_bounce` | Sandbox only: make an outbox email bounce; the person goes on do-not-contact. *(sandbox mode only)* |
| `simulate_reply` | Sandbox only: play the recipient and reply to an outbox message; runs the real reply handling (sequence stops, reply appears to label). *(sandbox mode only)* |
| `skip` | Skip drafts; the sequence moves on to its next step. |
| `start_sequence` | Start a sequence for people (by id). |
| `status` | The instance at a glance: mode (sandbox or live), loaded products with their sequences, how many product folders failed to load, active pauses, and whether AI drafting is on. |
| `themes` | The saved themes for a product and ISO week (default this week), or an empty answer if none were saved. |
| `today` | What is waiting on the operator, most urgent first: replies to label, drafts to approve (exact sender, recipient, text and flags), held, blocked, failed or unknown sends with their reason, and tasks due today. |
| `top_prospects` | Highest-priority people for a product who aren't excluded, with the score breakdown (fit/intent/why_now) and whether they were already contacted. min_tier defaults to B. |
| `update_account` | Edit an account: goal (what they want to achieve), timing (what is driving the timing), baseline (how they do it today), people with roles (person id or email; remove=true takes one off; an unknown email is added as a new person) and evidence links. |
| `updates_add` | Ask someone to join a product's updates list, by hand (for example they asked in person). |
| `updates_export` | Confirmed subscribers of a product as CSV (email, name, confirmed_at, confirmed_via, source). |
| `updates_subscribers` | The updates list (opt-in email list) of a product with counts: pending (asked, not yet confirmed), confirmed, unsubscribed, expired and bounced, plus subscribers (filter by status). |
| `updates_unsubscribe` | Take someone off the updates list (by email) at once; nothing queued for them goes out. |
| `week_notes` | Everything from one ISO week's conversation notes gathered for the weekly review (their words, problems, current approaches, survey answers, pricing reactions, assisted counts) plus the instructions for grouping them into themes. |
| `weekly_review` | Build the weekly review for a product and ISO week (default this week, like 2026-W43): one page of counts, each with its denominator and window, that answers the Friday questions. |
| `write_draft` | Set a draft's text (email subject/body, or the note for a manual LinkedIn/X task). |
